title: Sequential race verifier
statement: Given two Boolean-output verifiers $M_1,M_2$ and a function $p_1$ from natural numbers to natural numbers, define a verifier on input lists $x,r$ as follows: run $M_1$ on $x$ and the prefix of $r$ of length $p_1(|x|)$. If it returns true, output true; otherwise run $M_2$ on $x$ and the suffix of $r$ after that prefix, outputting false if it returns true and no answer otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $M_1,M_2$ map pairs of Boolean lists to Booleans
$p_1$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
